name: Territory Capture
summary: Territory capture is the main objective. A captured territory gives the team a new spawn location.
role: Stand in the flag area to capture the territory. A Furry in the area stops your capture progress. The capture progress decreases when no contractor is in the area.
fun_facts: A neutral flag requires approximately 30 seconds when one contractor is present and no Furries contest it.
An empty neutral flag slowly loses capture progress.

name: Deployment
summary: Deployment lets you spawn at a territory that your team controls.
role: Select a territory that your team controls. You cannot select a territory while enemies contest its flag.
fun_facts: The forward deploy list uses town names instead of flag numbers, so players see Whiskerhold, Furward, Furrow, and the rest of the route.

name: Furry Waves
summary: Furry waves send groups of enemies against the team.
role: The number of enemies changes with the mode and the number of players. In Rush, the enemies attack Furrow.
fun_facts: Rush sends active Furries to Furrow. It does not distribute them across the full territory route.

name: Boss Unlock
summary: The boss becomes available in Traditional mode after the team captures all six enemy territories.
role: Capture Furward, Furrow, Purridge, Whisken, Bloodwhisk Reach, and Whiskspire. Hold these territories to start the boss fight.
fun_facts: The boss unlock count does not include Whiskerhold because Whiskerhold is the initial base.

name: Boss Core
summary: The boss core can restore health to the boss during the final fight.
role: Attack the core to reduce the health that it gives to the boss.
fun_facts: The core health and boss difficulty scale with active fighters, so a bigger group changes the numbers behind the fight.

name: RallyDrop Vehicle Call-In
summary: RallyDrop lets you call a vehicle to a nearby location. Your gamepasses control which vehicles you can call.
role: Use RallyDrop to move the team or to use a vehicle weapon. You can have one active vehicle, or two with the Double Commander gamepass.
fun_facts: RallyDrop can driver-lock an owned vehicle and kick occupants from it.
Green is the default RallyDrop paint color.

name: Vehicle Resupply
summary: A vehicle resupply pad repairs a vehicle and fills its weapon ammunition.
role: Drive a damaged vehicle onto a resupply pad. Wait for the pad to repair and resupply the vehicle.
fun_facts: Vehicle resupply restores health as well as weapon ammunition.
Vehicles without weapons do not get a weapon-ammo refill from the resupply logic.
